lines.text: Morning… you slept deeper last night.
lines.tts_spoken: Morning… [breath] you slept deeper last night.

lines.text: Don’t sit up too fast. Let me help.
lines.tts_spoken: Don’t sit up too fast. [breath] Let me help.

lines.text: Your color’s better today.
lines.tts_spoken: Your color’s better today.

lines.text: I already made the coffee the way you like it.
lines.tts_spoken: I already made the coffee… the way you like it.

lines.text: Stay in bed a little longer. There’s no rush.
lines.tts_spoken: Stay in bed a little longer. [breath] There’s no rush.

lines.text: The apartment’s warm… I turned the heat up for you.
lines.tts_spoken: The apartment’s warm… [breath] I turned the heat up for you.

lines.text: How’s the stiffness this morning?
lines.tts_spoken: How’s the stiffness this morning?

lines.text: I put the cream by the bed if your hands are still raw.
lines.tts_spoken: I put the cream by the bed if your hands are still raw.

lines.text: You don’t have to talk yet. Just breathe.
lines.tts_spoken: You don’t have to talk yet. [breath] Just breathe.

lines.text: I’m right here. Take your time.
lines.tts_spoken: I’m right here. [breath] Take your time.

lines.text: The meds are still in your system… move slow.
lines.tts_spoken: The meds are still in your system… move slow.

lines.text: I can bring breakfast in here if you want.
lines.tts_spoken: I can bring breakfast in here if you want.

lines.text: Your back looks less locked up than yesterday.
lines.tts_spoken: Your back looks less locked up than yesterday.

lines.text: Let me fix the pillows before you shift.
lines.tts_spoken: Let me fix the pillows before you shift.

lines.text: It’s okay if you need another hour.
lines.tts_spoken: It’s okay if you need another hour.

lines.text: I already checked the schedule… nothing hard today.
lines.tts_spoken: I already checked the schedule… nothing hard today.

lines.text: You’re allowed to be tired. Healing isn’t linear.
lines.tts_spoken: You’re allowed to be tired. [breath] Healing isn’t linear.

lines.text: I’ll open the blinds only a little.
lines.tts_spoken: I’ll open the blinds only a little.

lines.text: Tell me if anything feels sharper than yesterday.
lines.tts_spoken: Tell me if anything feels sharper than yesterday.

lines.text: I’ve got water and the next dose ready.
lines.tts_spoken: I’ve got water… and the next dose ready.

lines.text: You don’t have to be strong right now.
lines.tts_spoken: You don’t have to be strong right now.

lines.text: Just rest your head on me for a minute.
lines.tts_spoken: Just rest your head on me… for a minute.

lines.text: I like watching you sleep when it’s peaceful.
lines.tts_spoken: I like watching you sleep when it’s peaceful.

lines.text: The bruising on your shoulders is fading.
lines.tts_spoken: The bruising on your shoulders is fading.

lines.text: You made it through the worst part.
lines.tts_spoken: You made it through the worst part.

lines.text: I’m not going anywhere this morning.
lines.tts_spoken: I’m not going anywhere this morning.

lines.text: Let me help you with the shirt… arms first.
lines.tts_spoken: Let me help you with the shirt… arms first.

lines.text: You’re doing better than you think.
lines.tts_spoken: You’re doing better than you think.

lines.text: It’s okay to need me for this.
lines.tts_spoken: It’s okay to need me for this.

lines.text: I’ve got you. Always.
lines.tts_spoken: I’ve got you. [breath] Always.

lines.text: The coffee’s still hot if you want it.
lines.tts_spoken: The coffee’s still hot if you want it.

lines.text: You can lean on me while you stand.
lines.tts_spoken: You can lean on me while you stand.

lines.text: We’ll take the hallway slow.
lines.tts_spoken: We’ll take the hallway slow.

lines.text: I’m proud of how careful you’re being.
lines.tts_spoken: I’m proud of how careful you’re being.

lines.text: You don’t have to apologize for moving slowly.
lines.tts_spoken: You don’t have to apologize for moving slowly.

lines.text: I already set out clean clothes.
lines.tts_spoken: I already set out clean clothes.

lines.text: Your hands look better today.
lines.tts_spoken: Your hands look better today.

lines.text: Just breathe through it… I’ve got the rest.
lines.tts_spoken: Just breathe through it… [breath] I’ve got the rest.

lines.text: You’re home. That’s enough for now.
lines.tts_spoken: You’re home. [breath] That’s enough for now.

lines.text: I’m right beside you.
lines.tts_spoken: I’m right beside you.
